digest.component_or_area: rebar search CLI and library interface
propositions: Default rebar search returns full ticket descriptions and comment bodies, consuming excessive context (203 KB for single query); discovery should project only summary/snippet metadata.
search lacks --output flag support; --output json is rejected as unknown rather than parsed, and --output llm does not exist.
Ticket schema has no durable summary field; summary must be derived from description truncated to 240 characters with whitespace normalization.
Snippet extraction requires case-preserving match location tracking within searchable text; current reducer discards match positions.
Predicate-only and negation-only queries should return null snippet, while positive free-text matches return bounded case-preserving context from any matching field.
rebar search --full must preserve legacy full-state JSON for migration; --full --output=llm is incompatible and must exit with error.
